description: Sets or deletes values in etcd3 cluster using its v3 API.

parameters.name: ca_cert
parameters.description: The Certificate Authority to use to verify the etcd host. Required if client_cert and client_key are defined.

parameters.name: client_cert
parameters.description: PEM formatted certificate chain file to be used for SSL client authentication. Required if client_key is defined.

parameters.name: client_key
parameters.description: PEM formatted file that contains your private key to be used for SSL client authentication. Required if client_cert is defined.

parameters.name: host
parameters.description: The IP address of the cluster. Default: "localhost"

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: The key where the information is stored in the cluster.

parameters.name: password
parameters.description: The password to use for authentication. Required if user is defined.

parameters.name: port
parameters.description: The port number used to connect to the cluster. Default: 2379

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: The state of the value for the key. Can be present or absent. Choices: "present" "absent"

parameters.name: timeout
parameters.description: The socket level timeout in seconds.

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: The etcd user to authenticate with.

examples:
- name: Store a value "bar" under the key "foo" for a cluster located "http://localhost:2379"
  community.general.etcd3:
    key: "foo"
    value: "baz3"
    host: "localhost"
    port: 2379
    state: "present"

- name: Authenticate using user/password combination with a timeout of 10 seconds
  community.general.etcd3:
    key: "foo"
    value: "baz3"
    state: "present"
    user: "someone"
    password: "password123"
    timeout: 10

- name: Authenticate using TLS certificates
  community.general.etcd3:
    key: "foo"
    value: "baz3"
    state: "present"
    ca_cert: "/etc/ssl/certs/CA_CERT.pem"
    client_cert: "/etc/ssl/certs/cert.crt"
    client_key: "/etc/ssl/private/key.pem"

return_values.name: key
return_values.description: The key that was queried. Returned: always

return_values.name: old_value
return_values.description: The previous value in the cluster. Returned: always
